newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Australian tyre firm seeking offers, trade dull.
newsitem.headline: Australian tyre firm seeking offers, trade dull.

text.p: An Australian tyre company has asked for offers of SMR20 or TSR20 rubber for nearby shipment, but the rest of the Singapore rubber market remains dull, dealers said on Thursday.
"The Australian company is asking for offers of TSR20 or SMR20 rubber for end-May or June shipment. They're trying to decide between buying from either Malaysia or Indonesia," a dealer said.
Bridgestone is also said to seeking offers in the market for SIR20 rubber, but there have been no reports of any deals so far, traders said.
The rest of the market languished in the morning due to weak consumer demand, they said.
"Most of the players just wait for the afternoon and don't do anything in the morning," one said.
"The market has no fundamental reason for it to push prices up," another dealer said.

At around 0430 GMT, May RSS3 was indicated at 115.00 U.S. cents a kg from 115.75 cents. May RSS1 was indicated unchanged at 166.00 Singapore cents (US$1.15) a kg. May TSR20 was indicated steady at 156.00 Singapore cents (US$1.08) a kg.
